dependency_edges.handoff: workflow sends requirements to premises and data
state definitions and sources enter base dynamics
base H-N-T equations receive intervention components
data choices and 2013 handling enter fitting
current states seed the intervention iteration
allocation and policy candidates define strategy combinations
AHP evaluation scores each candidate state
candidate scores and constraints determine the selected strategy
selected model defines global sensitivity outputs
Juneau structure and baseline enter local analysis and transfer
global screening informs interpretation of local effects
transfer and sensitivity bound generalizability claims
